approval: Human rejected first samples for realism/emotion. Root relayed approval to redo up to 8 samples within the SAME cumulative CNY1 cap, no 16-line expansion, no production integration.
parameter_evidence: Official RunningHub contract text field explicitly supports (inhale), (exhale), (chuckle), (breath). emotion enum supports happy, angry, surprised, neutral. speed .5–2, pitch -12–12. No instructions field is sent.

samples.name: 星璃
samples.brief: 明亮自信、起手吸气，干脆抛出爆发句
samples.text: (inhale)いくよっ！　私の歌で、輝けっ！

samples.name: 星璃
samples.brief: 轻笑开场、俏皮号召，保留短促尾音
samples.text: (chuckle)さあっ！　もっと、盛り上がろっ！

samples.name: 绯音
samples.brief: 短促出力声、低一点的音高、愤怒而有控制
samples.text: (inhale)はっ！　その隙、もらったぁ！

samples.name: 绯音
samples.brief: 用舞步台词做强释放，前短后长
samples.text: (exhale)燃えろっ！　最後まで、踊り抜く！

samples.name: 雾白
samples.brief: 温柔但有急迫感，不再平铺安慰播报
samples.text: (inhale)大丈夫っ！　私が、守るから！

samples.name: 雾白
samples.brief: 先坚定阻止、再温柔鼓励，有句内情绪转折
samples.text: (breath)大丈夫！　ほら、顔を上げて。

samples.name: 夜莺
samples.brief: 压低声线、前句收住，后句干脆爆发
samples.text: (inhale)逃がさない。　この一撃で、決めるっ！

samples.name: 夜莺
samples.brief: 更短更有节拍，分句咬字果断
samples.text: (exhale)聴けっ。　これが、私のビート！
